trickyParts: Bun 1.3.14's synchronous spawn timeout (execFileSync/spawnSync/Bun.spawnSync) does not reliably fire on this host: about half of 8 runs of a 1 s timeout on `sleep 5` returned after 5 s with status 0. queryTmux now uses an async spawn bounded by a timer that SIGKILLs and cancels the stdout read; cancelling the read is what lets the process exit when a grandchild holds the pipe.

The bridge watchdog runs under the caller's errexit: an unguarded kill of a port-forward already gone ended it before it signalled, so a preempted bridge pod (kube-dns, system-cluster-critical, 2026-10-26 21:30Z) turned into a misleading timeout minutes later.

The keeper adopts a moved row only when a pending save left exactly Held bytes and the row's bytes from that save's start offset hash to what it sent: a length alone can tell neither two of our saves of one length apart nor our save from another writer's row of the same length.
